title: Request REST API Access
description: Request access to REST API endpoints

elements.name: sla_info
elements.html:
SLA:

REST API access requests are typically processed within 5-7 business days. High-rate requests (>1000 requests/hour) require infrastructure review and may take up to 10 business days. API tokens are generated after approval and sent via secure email.

elements.name: important_notes
elements.html:
Important Notes:
  • Be specific about which endpoints you need - not all endpoints require separate approval
  • API tokens have expiration dates - you'll need to rotate them periodically
  • Rate limits are enforced - accurately estimate your request volume to avoid throttling
  • SQL API and Delta Sharing API have different approval processes - specify correctly
  • API access is workspace-specific - request access for each workspace you need
  • Store API tokens securely - never commit them to version control
  • High-volume API usage may require dedicated infrastructure - mention this in your justification
